Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjay Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anuj Pratap Singh,Anurag Mishra Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
Sri Anuj Pratap Singh, learned counsel has received notice on behalf of respondent No.4.

Challenge is to the order dated 21.4.2022 passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer on the ground that the application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has been rejected on highly technical ground.

It is contended that though the land acquisition reference was decided by the competent Court on 4.4.2012 and the compensation for the land in question was finalized, the petitioner had moved an application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on 4.7.2012 itself, but it was not marked in the office of Special Land Acquisition Officer uptill 12.7.2012, and the application has Vikram Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93060576/
1 been treated beyond time by 9 days.

entities.text: Vikram Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The contention is that the period during which the application remained in the office of Special Land Acquisition Officer, without adverting to it, cannot be saddled upon the petitioner.
Be that as it may, a perusal of the record indicates that the petitioner was not aware of the award of the land reference which was passed on 4.4.2012.
After getting the award, if the petitioner moved an application by delay of 9 days, it should have been condoned by the Special Land Acquisition Officer.
The rejection order, being highly technical is, therefore, set aside.
The matter is relegated back to the Competent Authority for fresh decision in accordance with law.
